newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila central bank sets o/night lending at 24 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila central bank sets o/night lending at 24 pct.

text.p: The Philippine central bank set its overnight lending rate at 24 percent on Tuesday following the three percentage-point cut in its overnight borrowing rate to 22 percent.
The central bank trimmed its closely-watched overnight borrowing rate on Monday, the third since the peso's de facto devaluation over two weeks ago.
It said it wanted to encourage banks to lower their lending rates and normalise credit growth.
